import os, tempfile
os.chdir(tempfile.mkdtemp())
import shutil, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date
os.makedirs("reports")
base = df.copy()
for m in ["jan", "feb"]:
    base.to_excel(f"reports/{m}.xlsx", index=False)
with pd.ExcelWriter("sales.xlsx") as w:
    base.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Jan", index=False); base.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Feb", index=False)
Path("old.csv").write_text("a,b")
files = list(Path("reports").glob("*.xlsx"))
assert len(files) == 2
Path("output").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path("old.csv").rename("new.csv")
assert Path("new.csv").exists()
shutil.copy("sales.xlsx", "output/sales.xlsx")
assert Path("sales.xlsx").exists()
assert Path("jan_sales.xlsx").stem == "jan_sales"
name = f"report_{date.today():%Y%m%d}.xlsx"
assert name.startswith("report_2") and name.endswith(".xlsx")
df = pd.read_excel("sales.xlsx", sheet_name="Jan")
assert len(df) == len(base)
sheets = pd.read_excel("sales.xlsx", sheet_name=None)
assert list(sheets) == ["Jan", "Feb"]
df = pd.concat(sheets.values(), ignore_index=True)
assert len(df) == 2 * len(base)
df = pd.concat(pd.read_excel(f) for f in files)
assert len(df) == 2 * len(base)
df.to_excel("output/final.xlsx", index=False)
df.to_csv("output/final.csv", index=False)
pv = df.pivot_table(index="region", values="sales", aggfunc="sum")
assert pv.loc["South", "sales"] == 2 * 3000
prices = pd.DataFrame({"product": ["Pen", "Mouse"], "list_price": [10, 450]})
mg = df.merge(prices, on="product", how="left")
assert len(mg) == len(df)
df = df.drop_duplicates()
assert len(df) == len(base) - 1
df["name"] = df["name"].str.strip()
assert df["name"].iloc[0] == "amit"
df.isna().sum()
df["city"].value_counts()
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
bym = df.groupby(df["date"].dt.month)["sales"].sum()
assert bym.loc[1] == 1400
df["sales"] = df["sales"].fillna(0)
assert len(df[df["sales"] > 1000]) == 2
assert df.sort_values("sales", ascending=False)["sales"].iloc[0] == 1800
assert df.nlargest(5, "sales")["sales"].tolist() == [1800, 1200, 900, 500, 450]
df["total"] = df["qty"] * df["price"]
df["city"] = df["city"].str.upper()
assert df["name"].str.split(" ", expand=True).shape[0] == len(df)
df = df.rename(columns={"qty": "units"})
df = df.drop(columns=["email"])
assert abs((df["sales"] / df["sales"].sum() * 100).sum() - 100) < 1e-9
assert df["sales"].cumsum().iloc[-1] == df["sales"].sum()
df["sales"].round(2)
assert len(df[df.duplicated("customer_id", keep=False)]) == 4
assert df.shape[0] == 7
print("office ok")
